bias.zh: 回调 · 跌破 10 日均线，位于 30 日均线

read.en: Amazon fell 3.3% on Nov 16 to $257.75, trading $256.68–262.92. It is below the 5-day ($265.8) and 10-day ($263.2), and just above the 30-day ($257.1), 100-day ($254.4) and 200-day ($244.7), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 4, above zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 4 ($244.69), and RSI is 49.6.
read.zh: 亚马逊 11月16日下跌 3.3%，收于 $257.75，盘中区间 $256.68–262.92。股价位于 5 日（$265.8）和 10 日均线（$263.2）下方，略高于 30 日（$257.1）、100 日（$254.4）和 200 日均线（$244.7），三者均在上行。MACD 自 11月4日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图收窄、临近下穿；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看多（$244.69），RSI 为 49.6。

read.en: The drop broke the $258.5–265.6 supports (Nov 6 low, 10-day, Nov 4 and 13 lows), now resistance, and the close sits on the 30-day. Resistance is $258.5–260.2, then $262.9–263.9 (10-day, Nov 13 low) and $271.5–275.3. Support is $256.7–257.1 (30-day, Nov 16 low), then $252.3–254.4 (Nov 5 low, 100-day) and $244.3–244.7 (200-day, SAR). A close above $263.9 would target $266–271.5; below $256.7, $252–254.
